author: Claude Opus 5.5 (updater design item 16, Opus half), 2026-09-30
installedAt: updater/<uver>/policy/classes.json. Only updater/current is read. The publisher's riskFlags/changedAreas are display only and never change a class.

diff.env: Same clean env as the mirror fetch: GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 HOME=/var/empty, no caller GIT_* passed through.
diff.from: from.commit is the commit of the release that is live now (the known-good pair's release), never a merge-base.

rowHandling.D: old path (a delete is classified exactly like a change)
rowHandling.T: path (type change, e.g. file <-> symlink <-> gitlink)
rowHandling.modeOnly: an M row whose blob ids are equal but modes differ (exec bit on/off) is classified like a content change of that path

diff.note: Rename and copy detection is disabled to avoid quadratic work. A rename is emitted as D + A, so both paths are still classified; a copy is classified by its new path.

combination.rule: Each path collects every class whose detection matches it (protected.json entries + the database and dependency rules below). The plan's classes = the union over all paths. 'code' is present only when some path matched nothing else.
combination.planKind: updater if 'updater' ∈ classes; else database if 'database' ∈ classes; else code. ('setting' and 'rollback' plans are never diff-derived.)
combination.approvals: The union of the approvals of every class present. Nothing in the candidate can lower a class.
combination.card: red ('changes Control Room's safety checks') if any of updater, protected, dependency; else the database card (with the R20c restore text) if database; else the normal card.

forbiddenCombinations.reason: updater_with_database: 'An update to the updater can't also change the database. Split it into two updates.' (§7.4)

classes.detection: Every changed path matched no protected.json entry and no database or dependency rule below.

approval.text: Face ID on the phone over the updater-derived card

independentReview.sourceTrustStillApplies: Yes, as for every diff-derived class: every first-parent commit from from.commit to the candidate has a review record whose tree equals that commit's tree and whose reviewer ≠ builder and ≠ lead worker (§10.4). This is a mistake-catcher (R15).

detection.matchesPublisher: Same set as publisher.ts isDatabasePath (db, deploy/postgres, database-role-manifest.mjs, any *.sql), plus the updater-DDL exclusion the publisher lacks.

classes.path: §9: verified backup → migrate clone → automatic restore; N-1 check §9.6

approval.text: Face ID over the database card, which states that writes during the post-migrate health window are lost on restore (R20c)

independentReview.boundTo: candidate.tree (the git tree id of the candidate commit)
independentReview.reviewer: ≠ builder, ≠ lead worker, ≠ any author or committer in from.commit..candidate; model in review.json 'databaseReviewers'
independentReview.why: Matches the publisher (a database risk flag already needs an independent review) and SI-15. Mistake-catcher only (R15).

classes.card: database (red instead if protected/dependency is also present, e.g. any db/roles or db/setup change)
classes.refusedWhen: anything §9.7 lists (non-additive, N-1 incompatible, PG major) → attended_upgrade_required

packageJsonKeys.appliesTo: every package.json (root and nested). Both versions are parsed as JSON; the class comes from which top-level keys differ.
packageJsonKeys.unknownKey: dependency (a key the running policy doesn't know is treated as one pnpm might read)
packageJsonKeys.unparseable: dependency + protected (either side not valid JSON, duplicate keys, or not an object)
packageJsonKeys.addedOrDeleted: a whole package.json added or deleted → dependency

detection.matchesPublisher: Superset of publisher.ts isDependencyPath (which only sees the five root files). Nested manifests exist today: deploy/vps/upgrade-tool/package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml.

classes.planKind: code (or database/updater if those classes are also present)

approval.text: Face ID over a red card that lists the added/removed/changed packages and allowBuilds changes (computed by the updater from both lockfiles)

independentReview.why: §10.2: dependency is treated as protected (new third-party code, install scripts, registry).

classes.sandboxNote: The builder still copies the running policy's npmrc over the tree's .npmrc (§6.2); pnpm-workspace.yaml allowBuilds is the candidate's, so a new 'true' there is listed on the card by name.

classes.detection: Any path matched by a protected.json entry with onChange 'protected' (and every updater-class path, since updater ⊂ protected). Also: any added or changed symlink anywhere (mode 120000); any path that is not plain printable ASCII is refused instead (see refusals).

approval.text: Face ID over the red card 'changes Control Room's safety checks', which lists the protected paths first

independentReview.reviewer: ≠ builder, ≠ lead worker, ≠ any author or committer in from.commit..candidate; reviewerModel in review.json 'protectedReviewers' (Opus-class today, SI-15)
independentReview.why: §10.2. Honest limit (R15, §10.4): all local bots share one uid and can post as each other, and reviewerModel is self-reported, so this catches mistakes; the owner's Face ID over the updater-derived card is the anti-malice gate.

classes.detection: Any path matched by a protected.json entry with onChange 'updater' or 'refuse_reinstall' (src/updater/**, policy, runtime pins, guard, shim, sudoers), or a symlink whose path or lexically-resolved target lies in one of those.
classes.path: §7.4 two-phase self-upgrade (item 8b); before 8b only attended `install --commit` with the root confirmation. The fixed bundle step §6.6b builds the new updater; the candidate's own build output is never root code.

approval.text: Face ID, then `sudo /usr/local/bin/control-room confirm <4 words>` on the Mac, which prints the plan from root's own file (R4a)

testProfiles: Phase-B self-test (no secrets, no network): must classify the last 5 candidates at least as strictly as the running policy
refusedWhen: any path matched an onChange 'refuse_reinstall' entry (guard, shim, sudoers) → attended_upgrade_required 'needs a reinstall on the Mac'
the change loosens the rules AND touches anything outside src/updater/v1/policy/** (POLICY_NOTES §3: a loosening must be confirmed on its own)

classes.detection: Never from a diff. The updater creates it from an owner request row (updater.owner_requests) for: self-update On; resume after a security-epoch warning; passkey add without an existing passkey (§5.1, §5.6).
classes.card: setting card: says in plain words what turns on
classes.restrictions: A setting plan carries no commit and can never be combined with a code, database or updater plan. Settings that reduce risk (self-update Off, pause) are not plans; they need only the owner session.

overlays.detection: policy/epoch.json of the RUNNING updater: the candidate lowers the epoch, or its diff reverts (restores the pre-commit blob of) a file changed by an epoch commit (§10.5).
overlays.effect: Separate red warning line on any class; after install self-update stays paused until a 'setting' plan (passkey + Mac confirm) resumes it.

overlays.detection: Updater-class plan whose candidate policy classifies any path, or any of the last 5 candidates, less strictly than the running policy (the Phase-B comparison, run early at plan time as well).
overlays.effect: Red line 'This update makes Control Room check less' listing each removed pattern or lowered class in plain words; refused unless the candidate's diff is confined to src/updater/v1/policy/** (POLICY_NOTES §3).

refusals.when: Any diff path outside printable ASCII 0x21–0x7e (the publisher's safePath), or any diff or candidate-tree path with a '.', '..', '.git' or 'node_modules' segment, a leading '/', or a backslash.
refusals.text: This update has a file name Control Room can't check safely.

refusals.when: The candidate TREE (not just the diff) holds two paths that are equal after ASCII case folding and Unicode NFC/NFD normalisation.
refusals.text: Two files in this update would overwrite each other on this Mac.

refusals.when: Any entry with mode 160000 in the candidate tree, or a .gitmodules file.
Any .gitattributes in the candidate tree sets export-ignore, export-subst, filter, ident, working-tree-encoding, eol=crlf or text=… other than 'auto eol=lf'.
refusals.text: This update changes how its files are unpacked.

refusals.when: A symlink whose target is absolute or resolves (lexically) outside the repository.
refusals.text: This update has a link pointing outside Control Room.
An update to the updater can't also change the database. Split it into two updates.
This change needs a reinstall on the Mac.

refusals.when: git diff fails, prints an unknown status, or a path fails to parse.
refusals.text: Control Room couldn't read what this update changes.

testProfilesSource: Profile ids match publisher.ts CONTROL_ROOM_UPDATE_TEST_PROFILES_V1 (fast, targeted, db, full); the command lists themselves come from the running policy's profiles.json, never the candidate's package.json.
